name: multi-select
title: Multi-select
description: Searchable multiple choices with removable selections, form values and clear validation.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible accessible label for the trigger and its choices.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected values. Values absent from options remain removable.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection when value is omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits one hidden form entry per selected value.

props.name: error
props.description: Sets the trigger's invalid state and announces the error.
